interpretation_notes: 11-class disease classification on 64 binary symptom features (n_train=565, n_test=142). Headline metric MAP@3 is the spec's MPA@3: per-row 1/rank of the true label if it lies in the top-3 predicted labels, else 0; averaged across rows. Submitting 3 labels per row maximises expected MPA@3, so we do that. Model is a soft-vote ensemble of LogisticRegression + RandomForest(600) + BernoulliNB on the binary features; CV is 5-fold stratified on the label. Hit@3 (label in top-3 ignoring rank) and top-1 accuracy are reported alongside for context.
